finding: With vLLM 0.30.0, the pinned helper produced large partial traces but no final status when the API server shut down its GPU worker, including with the adapter's API-server-only SIGTERM. The worker was force killed during vLLM shutdown.

order: finish and persist every scheduled measured request and record the measurement end marker
while the server and GPU workers are still alive, send a stop request to each initialized per-process CUPTI helper
wait at most 30 seconds per process for an explicit stop acknowledgment and finalized trace and status files
verify status, process identity, trace integrity, and loss counters before sending the server its normal SIGTERM
retain the subsequent server exit, worker exits, and all raw files without replacing or repairing failed attempts
proposed_direct_cupti_stop_rule.control_channel: one owner-only Unix-domain socket inside each helper's unique 0700 per-process output directory; socket mode 0600; no network listener
proposed_direct_cupti_stop_rule.measurement_boundary: the stop request occurs after the measured request window; helper process and idle control thread remain in the profiled mode's measured resource and latency overhead
proposed_direct_cupti_stop_rule.missing_or_failed_ack: mark capture partial or failed, retain every partial trace, status, command, exit, and timestamp; never infer zero loss or a completed trace
proposed_direct_cupti_stop_rule.unexpected_target_exit: retain partial artifacts and nonzero exit; best-effort atexit finalization is not counted as guaranteed coverage
proposed_direct_cupti_stop_rule.process_population: record all discovered vLLM server and worker PIDs, identify which initialized CUDA helpers emitted control endpoints, and require a finalized report for each such helper; any unresolved CUDA process is inconclusive

required_validation_before_final_observa: pin the revised helper source and binary hashes
CPU tests for concurrent per-process output isolation, stop acknowledgment, missing acknowledgment, nonzero exit, timeout, and partial-trace retention
one bounded L4 hardware smoke confirming complete status for every initialized vLLM CUDA helper under normal API-server shutdown
repeat the exact nominal and approved W4 control checks without treating failed preflight smokes as final repetitions
explicit approval of this stop rule and revised helper configuration
separate explicit authorization for final trials
